meta.title: Checkboxes
meta.lead: The native `<input type="checkbox">` with a custom and responsive style.

blocks.label: Checkboxes example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Checkboxes example" class="component"><fieldset><legend>Language preferences:</legend><label><input checked="" name="english" type="checkbox"/>English</label><label><input checked="" name="french" type="checkbox"/>French</label><label><input name="mandarin" type="checkbox"/>Mandarin</label><label><input name="thai" type="checkbox"/>Thai</label><label aria-disabled="true"><input disabled="" name="dothraki" type="checkbox"/>Dothraki</label></fieldset></article>
blocks.code:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Language preferences:</legend>
  <label>
    <input type="checkbox" name="english" checked />
    English
  </label>
  <label>
    <input type="checkbox" name="french" checked />
    French
  </label>
  <label>
    <input type="checkbox" name="mandarin" />
    Mandarin
  </label>
  <label>
    <input type="checkbox" name="thai" />
    Thai
  </label>
  <label aria-disabled="true">
    <input type="checkbox" name="dothraki" disabled />
    Dothraki
  </label>
</fieldset>

blocks.label: Horizontal stacking example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Horizontal stacking example" class="component"><fieldset><legend>Language preferences:</legend><input checked="" id="hindi" name="hindi" type="checkbox"/><label for="hindi">Hindi</label><input id="swahili" name="swahili" type="checkbox"/><label for="swahili">Swahili</label><input disabled="" id="navi" name="navi" type="checkbox"/><label aria-disabled="true" for="navi">Na'vi</label></fieldset></article>
blocks.code:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Language preferences:</legend>
  <input type="checkbox" id="hindi" name="hindi" checked />
  <label htmlFor="hindi">Hindi</label>
  <input type="checkbox" id="swahili" name="swahili" />
  <label htmlFor="swahili">Swahili</label>
  <input type="checkbox" id="navi" name="navi" disabled />
  <label htmlFor="navi" aria-disabled="true">Na'vi</label>
</fieldset>

blocks.md: You can change a checkbox to an indeterminate state by setting the `indeterminate` property to `true`.

blocks.label: Indeterminate checkbox example
blocks.code:
<label>
  <input type="checkbox" id="indeterminate" name="indeterminate" />
  Indeterminate
</label>

<script>
  const checkbox = document.querySelector('#indeterminate');
  checkbox.indeterminate = true;
</script>

blocks.label: Validation states example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Validation states example" class="component"><label><input aria-invalid="false" name="valid" type="checkbox"/>Valid</label><label><input aria-invalid="true" name="invalid" type="checkbox"/>Invalid</label></article>

  <input type="checkbox" name="valid" aria-invalid="false" />
